title: Sticker Collage: From one spark to a whole network

scenes.title: Spark to system
scenes.purpose: Show an idea sticker becoming a connected system of die-cut stickers on one flat dark dot-grid surface.
visuals: Stationary ink-navy (#13222A) field with a faint dot grid
White heading with the word network in coral (#D78267)
Coral bulb sticker with a slate base, alpha-dilated white border and contact shadow
Four round node stickers in sage, slate and coral
Seeded Rough.js hand-drawn connectors in pale blue-grey
White label sticker reading IDEA → SYSTEM

beats.development: The bulb sticker arrives lifted, with a large offset shadow and its top-right corner peeled back. It drops and rotates into place, and the shadow tightens as it lands. The peeled corner is then smoothed flat while a short white spark burst radiates outward.
captions: From one spark to a whole network

beats.development: Node stickers pop down one at a time, each with a slight rotation and a press-in lift. A rough connector draws from the bulb to the hub, then from the hub to each node as the nodes land.
The label sticker is slapped on with its corner folded, then the fold is smoothed flat. The IDEA → SYSTEM copy appears only once the label is complete.
Settled hold: the whole sticker network and both lines of copy stay still and readable.
captions: From one spark to a whole network

findings: The bulb is the only focus for the first 0.85s. Later actions overlap slightly so that each link draws as its node lands.
All motion is complete by 2.41s, before the 2.7s settle requirement.
The heading is static and readable for the full 3s. The label copy is only revealed after its container is flat.
justifiedHolds: 2.41–3.0s: a final reading hold on the completed system and label.

notes: The background follows palette.background_policy scene_dependent. An ink-navy dot grid replaces the previous warm notebook page, following the review's dark-field and white-border-contrast guidance.

No preview recipe was supplied (tech.preview_recipes is absent, and the optional recipe list is empty). The refresh covers the source-frame background review and the core implementation: alpha-mask expansion, lift and placement transforms, and a procedural paper fold.
